`docs/tickets/322_P35.43__watch-producer-v1.md`

## The problem

`web/watch.json` shipped an empty surface: `raw["contract_watch"]`
was a declared-unproduced read (F-481) — nothing filled it, so the
watch listed nothing and the coverage it could have stated never
existed. The six §5.2 derivation rules existed only on paper.

## What landed

- **`exports/src/exports/watch.py`** (new) — `WATCH_QUERIES`
  (`watch_claims` over publishable claim rows for notices, agenda
  items, contracts, bills and grants, subject key via a `JOIN
  LATERAL` on `entity_identifier`, plus the catalog's read-only
  `watch_subject_counts` sizing query) and `build_watch_payload` —
  the six §5.2 rules verbatim: `renewal_deadline` = `end_date −
  notice_window_days` when `auto_renews` (certainty `derived` via
  `_next_decision_date`), `contract_expiry` at `end_date` with
  `upper_bound` certainty (and an opened `contract_expiring`
  research task; `auto_renews: false` on record makes the date
  `stated`, never guessed), `solicitation_deadline`,
  `agenda_item`, `legislative_action`, `grant_period_end` (`stated`).
  Items carry the `sig.watch-item/1` field set (handle
  `W-<place>-<kind>-<slug>-<hash4>` minted only after §5.3 placement
  runs; `unplaced` is a data-quality bucket, never a guessed place;
  federal items sit under `iso3166-1:US`), the 30-day
  `recently_decided` drop, the status vocabulary
  (`upcoming`/`today`/`recently_decided`/`withdrawn` — retraction
  reads withdrawn, a revising claim drives the date), supersession
  (a claim superseded when *another* revises it), and the
  publication-withdrawal filter mirrored inside the producer.
  The envelope is `sig/watch/2` with the per-place coverage block —
  an empty result arrives *with* its coverage statement.
- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** — splices
  `WATCH_QUERIES` into `EXPORT_QUERIES`, drops `contract_watch` from
  `DECLARED_UNPRODUCED_READ_KEYS`, rebuilds `_watch()` to emit the
  v2 envelope (places seeded from `dataset.jurisdictions`), and
  hoists `lane_by_source` ahead of the surfaces dict so watch
  evidence links share the statements' J3 §5.3 upstream gate — one
  lane derivation feeds statements, provenance *and* watch; the
  ungated `artifact_url` fallback is gone. `raw["watch_items"]`
  hands the produced rows to analytics (counted as produced by the
  producer check's `_WRITE_RE`).
- **`exports/src/exports/analytics.py`** — `_decision_point` reads
  `raw["watch_items"]` (the produced derived rows); semantics
  unchanged.
- **`web/src/lib/data.ts`** — `getWatch()` is dual-shape: a
  `sig/watch/2` envelope maps `renewal_deadline`/`contract_expiry`
  items back to the legacy `ContractWatchItem` (termination block
  `{auto_renews, notice_window_days, expiry_date}`) — the
  back-compat bridge while the surface rows (P36.59) consume v2
  natively; the legacy array shape still parses.
- **`docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json`** —
  `watch` is the `sig/watch/2` envelope schema; `WatchItem` +
  `WatchCoverage` defs added (`ContractWatchItem` retained).
- **`tests/exports/test_watch.py`** (new, 24 tests) — the six
  derivations on a fixture spine; `upper_bound` never reads
  "deadline"; evidence links gated by lane; placement `unplaced`;
  empty emission carries coverage; status words; retraction →
  withdrawn; revision drives the date; the 30-day drop; the federal
  floor.

## Out of scope (named owners)

Watch pages, facets, dossier block, item pages — P36.59 (row 402,
WX-04a). Feeds and the watch lane — P37.34/P37.33 (rows 458/457,
WX-04b/WX-03); D-K7-5 rides them. The dated decision predicates
`agenda_item` needs — P37.31 (row 455, WX-02): absent inputs yield
no items, never synthetics. The evidence recommender repair —
P37.30 (row 454, WX-05). The `contract_expiring` detector + renewal
research tasks — P37.32 (row 456, WX-06). Empty-state copy — WX-07.
